review_evidence: The unit contains 472 primary Lean files generated by the InstCombine extract-goals pipeline, each exposing an extracted theorem statement rather than non-formal test output.

Representative declarations include lt_signed_to_large_unsigned_thm.extracted_1._1, neg_sgt_0_thm.extracted_1._1, sext_sub_const_thm.extracted_1._2, covering fixed-width bitvector shifts, comparisons, casts, logical operations, or extension identities.

The files retain the logical obligations as named Lean theorems (typically with sorry bodies); generated provenance and test-tree placement do not make these distinct statements content-lossless to remove.
summary: Retain this InstCombine extracted-goals bucket: all 472 primary files are standalone bitvector/LLVM theorem obligations with independent formal benchmark and theorem-search value.
